approach: Static PowerPC recompilation with DolRecomp and the ModernGekko runtime, supported by ongoing matching decompilation and targeted native replacements.
notes: Recompilation-first project backed by ongoing matching decompilation. Recovered source informs analysis, correctness work and native replacements without requiring a fully decompiled game. Development builds have verified gameplay on Windows, Linux and macOS; performance and compatibility work remains. No game data is distributed.
